name: bootstrap_patricians
description: D-062 reference replay: original build order and island assignment, footprints replanned locally; surgery deferred until Patricians and glass. No stock grants, pauses or target changes. Farms moved off the start island (the D-065 chain plots leave isle-01 too little grass for its last wheat_farm, and wheat grows only on isle-01 among the settled islands): the 11th to 14th pig_farm stand on isle-06, served by a fourth cog on a new route 4 (stone out, pigs home); later ships and routes are renumbered; the eighth wheat_farm comes before the second apiary.

quarters.note: D-074: settlers for workforce and twelve Merchant houses; serves needs the chains declared again in this segment.

actions.note: D-074: the Merchants game builds no sheep farm and weaver for home-2 any more; the settlers of isle2-1 need the garments.

D-074: Merchant houses hold about 20 residents at their settled satisfaction (not 25), so the patrician push needs more houses and more planks: two lumberjacks and four sawmills more (the home island's wood ran full).
D-074: the start stock carries no sails; the hulks and the carrack need hemp beyond the first hemp farm.
D-074: home-6 adds settlers (the workforce of the home island ran short) and twelve more Merchant houses, the ones 1200 merchants need at about 20 residents each.
D-074: bread beside cheese — the citizens' food was short with cheese alone.
D-072: the 33rd to 36th house of home-3 stand in home-5 (the chain plots of this terrain take home-3's last house land).
D-069: before the pig farms of this round, which otherwise take the grass it needs next to the warehouses reach asks for.
D-069: the last wheat farm right after the round's first one, before the pastures and small buildings fragment the grass.
D-069: pig farms #13–14 on isle-06 too (pig route): the warehouses reach asks for take the home grass of the last wheat farm.
D-069: on isle-06 (milk home on the pig route): the warehouses reach asks for take the home grass this pasture needed.
D-074: hemp rides along until the hulks are ordered (no sails in the start stock); the later update drops it so the thread fits the hulk's four slots.
D-074: the twelve extra Merchant houses of home-6, just before the winepress waits for the unlock.

D-072 part 2: the deposit-slot rule moved the dev seed's layout and isle-02 lies farther from home (a 27-minute loop): one carrack no longer carries enough cattle and pigs (roast beef and sausages ran short in the final wait): a second carrack on the farm-goods route, a hulk with the pigs that pile up on isle-06 and the roast-beef chain right with the farm-goods route (three cattle farms on isle-02 with three more houses for their workers, two slaughterhouses at home), not after the cathedral: built after it, hardly any cattle reached home before the end.
D-074: sixty Merchant houses drink more beer: five more breweries, five wheat farms and a hulk for hops alone.
Level 4 needs Patricians (D-065 extended to the Trading Post): after the first Patrician house.
D-072: coats and sausages ran short in the final wait (the tailors and butchers starve for pigs): a seventh leather works, a tenth tailor and three more pig farms on isle-02.
